layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Towards a glaucoma risk index based on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: simulated hemodynamics from fundus images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: José Ignacio Orlando¹, João Barbosa Breda2, Karel van Keer2,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Matthew B. Blaschko3, Pablo J. Blanco4, and Carlos A. Bulant1

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1 CONICET - Pladema Institute, UNICEN, Argentina

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2 Research Group Ophthalmology, KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3 ESAT-PSI, KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: National Laboratory for Scientific Computing, LNCC/MCTIC, Petrópolis, Brazil.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract. Glaucoma is the leading cause of irreversible but preventable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: blindness in the world. Its major treatable risk factor is the intra-ocular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pressure, although other biomarkers are being explored to improve the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: understanding of the pathophysiology of the disease. It has been recently

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: observed that glaucoma induces changes in the ocular hemodynamics.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, its effects on the functional behavior of the retinal arterioles

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have not been studied yet. In this paper we propose a first approach for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: characterizing those changes using computational hemodynamics. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: retinal blood flow is simulated using a 0D model for a steady, incompress-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ible non Newtonian fluid in rigid domains. The simulation is performed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on patient-specific arterial trees extracted from fundus images. We also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: propose a novel feature representation technique to comprise the out-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: comes of the simulation stage into a fixed length feature vector that can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be used for classification studies. Our experiments on a new database of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fundus images show that our approach is able to capture representative

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: changes in the hemodynamics of glaucomatous patients. Code and data

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are publicly available in https://ignaciorlando.github.io.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1 Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Glaucoma is a neurodegenerative condition that is the the leading cause of irre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: versible but preventable blindness [1].The disease is characterized by the inter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ruption in the communication between the retinal photoreceptors and the brain,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: preventing visual signals to be carried to the brain via the optic nerve [1]. These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: progressive changes are asymptomatic until advanced stages of the disease, when

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: undiagnosed patients notice the disease when a considerable amount of visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: field has been lost. The major treatable glaucoma risk factor is the intra-ocular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pressure (IOP), although individuals with high IOP might not develop glaucoma

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and subjects with normal IOP values can develop it [2]. Hence, alternative ge-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: netic, vascular, anatomical or systemic factors are being extensively studied to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: better understand the pathophysiology of glaucoma [2,3].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The ocular hemodynamics has long been observed to be affected by glau-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coma [2,4] through imaging modalities such as color Doppler imaging or laser

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Orlando et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Doppler flowmetry, among others [4]. These tools provide non-invasive measure-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments of hemodynamic parameters from ocular vascular structures such as the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: central retinal artery (CRA), the ophthalmic artery (OA) or the retinal capillary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network. In turn, the analysis of the hemodynamic characteristics of the retinal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: arterioles and venules, easily accessible through fundus photography, has been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: limited despite the availability of this imaging modality for several decades.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we propose a first approach to characterize the hemodynam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ics of the retinal microvasculature of glaucomatous and control subjects based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on computer simulations performed on vascular networks extracted from fundus

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images (Fig. 1). Our method is based on patient-specific graph representations of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the arterial network that are used as the topological vascular substrate to build

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 0D models, which account for the steady, incompressible flow of a non Newto-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nian fluid (the blood) in rigid domains. Although simpler than fully 3D [5] or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2D [6] blood flow models, 0D models (also known as lumped parameter models)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are computationally cheaper and, thus, enable the simulation of blood flow in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large networks of vessels [7]. Similar modeling approaches have been used before

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the context of retinal hemodynamics simulation. In [7], the blood hematocrit

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is incorporated as transport species in the model, considering constant cross-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sectional radius per vessel segment in a network of arteries and veins of a mouse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model. More recently, 0D modeling has been applied in [8] for characterizing ab-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: normal changes due to diabetic retinopathy. Although the simulation approach

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is similar to ours, a Newtonian fluid model was used in [8]. Furthermore, in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stead of using the whole retinal network, the numerical experiments have been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performed in a single vascular bifurcation, which was manually isolated for each

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image. As a further novel aspect of the present study, the simulation outcomes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are summarized in a fixed-length feature vector using a novel technique inspired

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the bag of words [9] technique for feature representation. This allows the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: characterization approach to be applied in combination with linear classifiers to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: study its relationship with the presence/absence of the disease. We empirically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: validate this approach on a new database, namely LES-AV, comprising 22 fun-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dus photographs with available manual segmentations of the retinal vessels and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: their expert classification into arteries and veins.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In summary, the key contributions of this study are: (i) a computational

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: workflow for quantifying patient-specific hemodynamics non-invasively; (ii) a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: feature representation technique to comprise the simulated outcomes into a fixed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: length feature vector; (iii) a first pilot study showing that glaucomatous patients

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: exhibit changes in the hemodynamic variables with respect to control subjects;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and (iv) a new database of fundus images that is released, jointly with code and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: implementation details, in https://ignaciorlando.github.io.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1444 × 1620 pixels (21 images), and 45° FOV and 1958 × 2196 pixels (one image),

layout_dets.text: 2.1 Preprocessing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Patient-specific segmentations of the retinal vasculature must be first retrieved

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from a fundus image, and subsequently classified into arteries and veins. Al-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: though several methods have been introduced for this purpose [10], we follow a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semiautomatic approach to ensure a proper input for the simulation step. Hence,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a first coarse segmentation of the vessels is obtained using a fully convolutional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: neural network [11] (see supplementary materials for details). The segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is then manually refined to improve the vessel profiles and their connectivity,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and each structure is manually labelled as artery or vein. Subsequently, the ar-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: teries are taken and their corresponding centerlines are automatically identified

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using a skeletonization method [12]. The result is a binary mask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.3 Bag of Hemodynamic Features (BoHF)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: One key aspect of the functional characterization is how to construct a feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vector F for discriminating control subjects from diseased. As

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is given for ev-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ery centerline pixel i, it is necessary to find an alternative feature representation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with a fixed length, suitable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for linear discriminant analysis. To this end,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we propose a new technique inspired by the Bag of Words (BoW) method [9],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: named as Bag of Hemodynamic Features (BoHF).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our analysis is focused on three relevant structures for the graph

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: u-th subject: the terminal and the bifurcation points, and the arterial segments.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For every pixel i being a terminal or a bifurcation point, the vector

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is used.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, for a given arterial segment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: , the average vector

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: over the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixels enclosed by the segment is used as a summary statistic. This allows our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: representation to lower its variance and to normalize for the length of an arterial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segment. The resulting vectors associated to each arterial segment, bifurcation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and terminal points are collected into a set, denoted X.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Let

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is the set of summary statistics at arterial segments, bifurcation and ter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: 3 Results

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4 Discussion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We have presented a first approach to characterize the retinal hemodynamics

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of glaucoma patients using computational fluid-dynamics. To the best of our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: knowledge, this is the first study in which the relationship between glaucoma

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and simulated hemodynamic outcomes of the retinal arterioles are studied.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The arterial radius was previously observed to be smaller in glaucoma pa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tients than in normal subjects [17], a setting that is consistent with our data. On

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the other hand, in-vivo velocity measurements in the CRA of affected patients

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: was shown to be lower than in control subjects [18]. Under these considerations,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we have used SC1 for the G group and SC3 for the H group in our first pilot

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: study, resulting in a simulated behavior that is in line with existing observa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions made on other measurable vessels (i.e.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [18]. Moreover, this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rendered physiologically correct values of ∆p in the retinal network.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The classification experiment based on BoHF and the unbiased SC2 outcomes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: showed an AUC different than random for identifying the glaucomatous patients,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: indicating that the tool is able to preserve the variations in the hemodynamics

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the arteries affected by the disease. Future efforts will be focused on incorpo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rating the venous network and also modeling of the IOP, which is relevant for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clinical studies [19]. Also, the incorporation of a deep learning based method for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: simultaneous segmentation and classification of the vasculature will be explored

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in order to allow a more efficient characterization of larger populations.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Finally, our MATLAB/C++/python code and the LES-AV database are pub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: licly released. To the best of our knowledge, our data set is the first in providing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: not only the segmentations of the arterio-venous structures but also diagnostics

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and clinical parameters at an image level.
